name: Term-Defined subscription (annual, renewable) with proration enabled
what_it_tests: A Term-Defined line with StartProrationPeriod and ItemSubscriptionTerm enters the term-defined proration path, stamps PricingTermCount, and creates an Asset lifecycle (SubscriptionEndDate, renewal automation >=90 days before expiry)
proc_mechanism: Term-Defined proration filter (SellingModelType='TermDefined' AND StartProrationPeriod IsNotNull AND ItemSubscriptionTerm IsNotNull); ProrationTermDefined element -> PricingTermCount; ListOperationTermDefinedPTC
expected_behavior: Term proration computed; PricingTermCount derived (1 annual or fractional); Asset.IsSubscription=true with SubscriptionEndDate=Start+term; renewal auto-created >=90 days prior
test_setup: Subscription software (e.g. Digital Guardian DLP yearly), Term-Defined, ItemSubscriptionTerm=12/36, StartProrationPeriod set, Qty=10
